title: Curricular Practical Training in Clinical Research
description: Student participates in a practical training experience in clinical research and submits a standardized program form, signed by both the experience supervisor and the course faculty, confirming at least twenty total hours of practical training in core graduate-level skills in clinical research. Examples of experiences include an internship (either unpaid or paid), or curricular practical training for international students. Prerequisites: admission to the MAS in Clinical Research Program or consent of department.
